faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before getting started.

items.question: Do I need to know Next.js to use this?
items.answer: Basic React knowledge helps, but the boilerplate is structured so you can copy a tool page, tweak the logic and ship. The folder layout is conventional and documented in the README.

items.question: Is authentication really included?
items.answer: Yes — Supabase Auth is wired up with email/password and Google OAuth placeholders. Add your project URL and anon key in the environment file to activate it.

items.question: How do payments work?
items.answer: Stripe Checkout is integrated as a placeholder. The pricing page calls a checkout function and there is a webhook route stub. Plug in your Stripe keys and price IDs to start charging.

items.question: Can I use this commercially?
items.answer: Absolutely. This boilerplate is meant to be the foundation of your own product. Build, rebrand and sell whatever you create with it.
